rationale: LOGI gapped down ~10.7% on earnings and is now consolidating mid-range (~40.6% of today's range) near VWAP ($100.45) and the 9-EMA ($100.09), with no clear directional momentum — the last five 1-minute candles show choppy, overlapping price action with no sustained trend. The positive earnings surprise is already priced into the gap structure, and the stock is caught between buyers defending the gap-fill low and sellers capping near the session high, making a directional edge difficult to identify. With an existing working long order already committed and today's realized P&L slightly negative, adding exposure here without a cleaner setup would increase risk without a commensurate edge.
